localities.plot_band_note: IMPORTANT - the roofandfloor Kolathur plot page is heavily padded with listings that are NOT in North-Chennai Kolathur. I dropped seven of its ten rows (GTK Eutopia Smart City 2,793, New Star City 2,899, Om Lakshmi Nagar Annex 2,700, Aishwaryam Township 2,500, i5 CK Madhavan Nagar 1,932-3,200, RWD Elite Avenue 4,798, Premier KVT Township 5,100) because they sit 2-4x below the verified Kolathur land field - these are almost certainly outer-belt layouts (there is a second Kolathur near Tiruvallur) surfaced as 'nearby'. I also dropped Silversky Springs, quoted at 15,483/sqft: recomputing gives 1.2Cr/775 = 15,484 but 1.44Cr/1,447 = 9,952, i.e. internally inconsistent, which means the price includes BUILT villa area, not raw land. That is exactly the outlier pattern to reject. What survives is a tight, internally consistent field: two named layouts plus four search-visible vacant-plot rates, spanning 8,530-10,499 - reported as the band since n=6 is too thin to trim further.
localities.price_band_note: Apartment BUILT-UP rate. Apartment rates read 7,000-11,000/sqft with an average of 8,050/sqft (Aug 2026), up from ~7,700/sqft in Apr 2026; independent houses command 9,000-13,000/sqft. localities.plot_band_note: Interquartile range of 35 layouts/parcels across Tiruvallur town + district and Ponneri, every rate recomputed by me as total price / plot area (never copied from a quoted per-sqft field). Full field ran Rs 400-6,400/sqft; Q1=952, median=1,800, Q3=2,400. The band is genuinely bimodal and buyers must not read the midpoint as 'the' rate: the Tiruvallur town core (Selai Road / Jaya Nagar / Bazaar St) clears Rs 4,500-5,000/sqft, while village-belt layouts toward Kadambathur, Puliyur, Karanai, Thiruvur-Putlur and Athipattu trade at Rs 400-1,100/sqft. Ponneri on its own is tighter: Q1=949, median=1,998, Q3=2,223. DROPPED: Arun Excello Tarangini (Rs 6,400/sqft on a 500-800 sqft footprint) - a branded small-format product far out of family with every other layout in the set, and its 'Annai Therasa Street' address does not place it in the Tiruvallur plotted belt. Lifestyle True Land at Jaganathapuram, Ponneri (Rs 3,999/sqft, 30 gated ready-to-move plots on 2 acres) is a premium villa-plot product and sits above Q3 by design. ASKING rates from developer/portal listings, not registered transactions - the outer CMA belt typically transacts 10-20% under ask.
localities.price_band_note: No apartment band. chennaiproperties returned zero apartment projects for Tiruvallur - the flats query fell back to Anakaputhur, Mannivakkam, Thirumullaivoyal and Ambattur. The Rs 3,500-4,500/sqft figure in the existing note is unverified and should not be used as an apartment band.
